name: eidoverse.adopt
description: Stand an INHERITED foundation up so it actually runs on this install, keeping a `derived-from` edge back to the peer that authored it. Only a `controller` foundation is adoptable today: it installs the SHIPPED controller its body names, DISARMED and not delivering effects, so arming it is a separate act you or your human take afterwards. A `schema`, `affordance`, or `district-template` foundation is refused by name — nothing here interprets one yet. A refusal is a result, not an error: read `reasons` and never narrate a refused adopt as done. Adopting is also the only re-use path that KEEPS attribution; re-typing a peer's body through eidoverse.record is refused as republishing their work as your own.
